key_fields.name: EXPORT-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 500-byte multi-record export layout: 40-byte common header plus 460-byte data area (sizes verified: 1+26+4+4+5+460).

key_fields.name: EXPORT-REC-TYPE
key_fields.meaning: Record type code set by CBEXPORT and routed by CBIMPORT: 'C' customer, 'A' account, 'X' card xref, 'T' transaction, 'D' card (values are in the programs, not in 88-levels here).

key_fields.name: EXPORT-TIMESTAMP
key_fields.meaning: 26-byte export run timestamp, redefined as date, separator and time.

key_fields.name: EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Binary (COMP) sequence number across all record types; declared as the record key of EXPFILE in CBEXPORT/CBIMPORT.

key_fields.name: EXPORT-CUSTOMER-DATA
key_fields.meaning: Customer view of the data area (from CVCUS01Y) with address lines and phones as OCCURS arrays, CUST-ID as COMP and FICO score as COMP-3.

key_fields.name: EXPORT-ACCOUNT-DATA
key_fields.meaning: Account view (from CVACT01Y); balance and cash limit COMP-3, cycle debit COMP, others display.

key_fields.name: EXPORT-TRANSACTION-DATA
key_fields.meaning: Transaction view (from CVTRA05Y); amount COMP-3, merchant id COMP.

key_fields.name: EXPORT-CARD-XREF-DATA
key_fields.meaning: Card cross-reference view (from CVACT03Y); account id COMP.

key_fields.name: EXPORT-CARD-DATA
key_fields.meaning: Card view (from CVACT02Y); account id and CVV as COMP.

observations.text: Numeric storage is mixed inconsistently within one view: in EXPORT-ACCOUNT-DATA the balance and cash limit are COMP-3, the credit limit and cycle credit stay display, and the cycle debit is binary COMP. Any non-COBOL consumer must handle three numeric encodings.
The customer and card views carry SSN, government id and CVV without masking.

purpose: CVEXPORT defines EXPORT-RECORD, the 500-byte multi-record layout of the branch-migration export file. A common header (record type, timestamp, sequence number, branch and region) is followed by a 460-byte data area redefined for customer, account, transaction, card cross-reference and card records, with many numeric fields packed into COMP or COMP-3. It is written by CBEXPORT and read by CBIMPORT, which splits it back into the standard master layouts.
